CHLOE BROOKS

Conservatory Flute / The Strategist

Profile Data
  • Band Role: Classical Woodwinds
  • Musical Background: Playing flute since 6th grade
  • Compound Role: The Academic Anchor
  • Tactical Specialty: Two-Person Leverage Transfers

The Missing Melody

Classically trained on the flute since the 6th grade, Chloe brings a premium, conservatory-level sophistication to Crimson Node's 1980s progressive rock sound. Because she was intensely focused on her academic research during the recording of the debut album, she couldn't bring her flute down to the garage studio in time. This absence is famously felt on the worldbeat track "The Vivarium," where Jessica had to step in with a quirky analog synth patch to cover the melody. To this day, Jessica loudly complains about wishing Chloe had been there to lay down the real acoustic tracks.

The Unbothered Strategist

In a house full of heavy cranes, naval artillery, and unfiltered agents of chaos, Chloe provides the essential academic anchor. She navigates the Albemarle County compound with absolute, unbothered energy. Highly strategic and deeply grounded, she doesn't engage in unnecessary drama, preferring to observe the ecosystem and apply her intelligence exactly where it's needed most. She is the quiet, intellectual force that balances out the intense, high-energy environment of the Kids House.

Clinical Leverage

When it comes to Matt's physical care, Chloe pairs up with Emily to form an unstoppable clinical tag-team. Relying on physics and leverage rather than brute force, Chloe executes two-person clinical lifts to safely transfer Matt with flawless, drama-free efficiency. Her absolute dedication to this platonic, boundary-free medical teamwork was entirely misunderstood by her insecure, lacrosse-bro ex-boyfriend Trent. His failure to comprehend the family's care architecture led directly to his legendary ejection from the compound—a move Chloe signed off on without a second thought.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)
